notes.title: UPDATE!! Localization + Matchmaking + New Costumes
notes.notes:
v2017112201

Localized in 17 different languages (English, German, Danish, Spanish, Finnish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Brazilian, Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, Turkish, and Chinese)

Matchmaking update: We reorganized the matchmaking system so that players will have a better chance at finding a match. There is no more ranked toggle-- all online games found through matchmaking are now ranked. Match settings have been locked to streamline the menu screens. 

None of the matchmaking updates change the way “invite a friend” works, so that still behaves just like local multiplayer.

We’ve added a few new (cosmetic) costume pieces, which unlock as you play online games and against strangers. You can change your costume from the Online menu.

“No Gore” confetti effect

Bug Fixes:
Fixed Arcade Highscores
Longsword now blocks while walking
Low stance Dagger now blocks slides
Added invisible wall to left side of center Airship room
Other things that I can’t remember


Thanks to our Discord community https://discord.gg/nidhogg for finding some of these!

notes.title: Hotfix v2017082501
notes.notes:
Hotfix v2017082501 (latest)
- steam screenshot support
- fixed text chat blocking input after quitting online mode
- changed some main menu ui elements
- back button backs out title submenus properly
- matchmaking improvements
- added pixel perfect window size preferences (you can still drag the window to resize)

ːwormheadː Trading cards are now live! ːn2ː

Hotfix v2017082001
- fixed crash with error message talking about footsteps
- fixed memory leak
- added summary of match rules to character screen
- f12 no longer resets the game

Hotfix v2017081601
- more fixes for matchmaking (players getting stuck on "connecting" screen)

Hotfix v2017081501
- fixed some matchmaking issues preventing players from connecting
